# Open-Shop Architecture & Build System

## 📁 Key Files & Roles

* `code/openshop.js`: The main application engine bundle, generated by `build-openshop.js`.
* `build-openshop.js`: Automated patching script that takes `pp/deobfuscated.js` and applies Open-Shop branding, logo injection, account button removal, link stripping, and error safety handlers.
* `style/all.css`: Master stylesheet defining `:root` variables, dark studio palette, window modal rules, scrollbars, and icon scaling.
* `index.html`: Entry point loading `style/all.css`, logger, recovery engine, memory guard, and core scripts.
* `promo/logo.svg`: The official blue Open-Shop logo (`#3b82f6` -> `#2563eb`).

## 🛠️ Build & Development Commands

```bash
# Rebuild core script after changes to build-openshop.js
node build-openshop.js

# Start local server
node server.mjs
```
